### 5.1 Primary Model (`diabetes_full_nhanes`)

| Metric | Empirical Value | Clinical / Governance Interpretation | Source Citation |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Dataset Splits (Clean n)** | 27,448 / 8,714 / 8,681 | Strict temporal split | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **Test Set Prevalence** | 4.15% | Natural population prevalence of undiagnosed diabetes | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **Chosen Algorithm (D10)** | lr ({'C': 0.1}) | L2 regularized logistic regression | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **Validation AUROC** | 0.7617 | Locked validation performance | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **Held-Out Test AUROC** | **0.7527 [0.7293–0.7748]** | Exceeds D11 gate (>= 0.75) | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **Test Sens / Spec / PPV** | 85.28% / 52.23% / 7.17% | High sensitivity screening calibration policy | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **Calibration Slope (Val / Test)** | 0.857 / 0.848 | Reliable risk probability estimates | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **Worst Subgroup Sensitivity** | age_band=40-59: 76.00% (n=125) | Exceeds D11 subgroup fairness threshold (>= 60%) | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **Card Population AUROC / Sens** | 0.6640 / 93.18% | Performance on high-risk card audience | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
| **FYP-1 Status** | **SHIP CANDIDATE (all D11 gates passed)** | Deployed as provider-only experimental panel | `docs/ml/EXPERIMENTS_SUMMARY.md:15` |
